evidence.description: Publicly accessible array property in a shared instance

candidates.explanation: The `subscriptions` array is a public property of a singleton class that is accessed and modified without any synchronization mechanism, which can lead to data races.
candidates.title: Thread Safety Issue with Shared State

evidence.description: Timer is activated in init but never invalidated

candidates.explanation: The `timer` is a property of the class, and its event handler captures `self`. While `weak self` is used, the timer itself is never invalidated, which can prevent the `TreesProjection` instance from being deallocated if it were not a singleton.
candidates.title: Potential Memory Leak / Retain Cycle

candidates.explanation: The timer is explicitly tied to the `.main` queue, which can block the UI thread if the `treesAt` calculation or the `send` operation becomes computationally expensive.
candidates.title: Hardcoded Dependency on Main Queue
